items.name: Ajax First-Timers 2022

venue.name: [Ajax Community Centre - HMS Community Hall](https://facilities.ajax.ca/Home/Detail?Id=db52c417-b7aa-40fe-8939-61304512694f)
venue.details: The HMS Community Hall is on the main floor of the community centre

items.information: This is a competition in a series with [Ajax NxNxN 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AjaxNNN2022). You will only be able to register for *one* of these two competitions. Attempting to register for more than one of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted. This competition is targeted towards new competitors, but you do not have to be a new competitor to register for this competition. **Reminder:** You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. We expect that registration will fill up fast, so please plan to be ready as soon as registration opens!

items.name: Ohio State Fall Scarlet 2022

organisers.name: The Rubik's Cube Club at Ohio State

venue.name: [Ohio Union](https://ohiounion.osu.edu)
venue.details: First Floor - Great Hall Meeting Room

items.information: # **This is a series competition with [Ohio State Fall Gray 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OhioStateFallGray2022). You may only register for and compete in one of the two competitions. If you have already registered (with payment) for Ohio State Fall Gray 2022, your registration for this competition will be rejected.** This competition will take place in the Great Hall Meeting Room, which is on the first floor near the east side. For those not competing in the 3x3 Multi-Blind, doors to the room will remain closed until the end of the event (10:20am EST), at which other competitors will be let in to set up.
